column1: #mapping_set_description: refgenie 1.x server genome listing, GET https://api.refgenie.org/v4/genomes?alias=... (OpenAPI schema PageResponse[GenomeResponse]). One record per genome in 'results'; unlike the detail record it lists every alias of the genome and an asset count, but has no FHR block.

column9: Lossy: Values are not normalized (ncbi, Ensembl, UCSC).
How many assets this server built; a server statistic.
Other names of the species; core keeps one common name.
